author: hasl
body:
Hello all o/,

So as you know the Moderators have recently been reassessed by the Senior Staff Team, in response to that I have created a survey to gather feedback from the community, you.

The results will be gathered and taken to thought.

Please complete this survey: https://blizzem.typeform.com/to/s22ZdG

Again, we really appreciate your opinions on this. Be honest, all submits are anonymous. However, if we find you have been trolling the survey you will then by punished accordingly.

This isn't the place for complaints, if you don't agree with the decisions then speak to a Sr Staff member via TS or Skype.

Kind regards,

-The Avicus Staff / Senior Staff Team.
